caption: Import dialog defaults: routes stay as drawn (re-routing off) and the import stays flat (grouping off).
The imported chip renders its original polygons — 2 µm core and 6 µm cladding ribbons, the mirrored device on the right.
Selecting the waveguide shows its fitted centerline (straights + two R = 40 µm bends) over the drawing; this is what simulation and A* use.
After 'Re-route selected' only this waveguide is routed by Lunima; the drawing disappears for it (Ctrl+Z restores it).
